task_confirmed_by_user: 一个房间空壳+需要的家具列表，然后下游对接roomgen

shell: known physical floor polygon and frame/units
known floor and height with missingness explicit
not_supplied_by_default: reference support or mined ground-truth relations
target validity or yaw symmetry metadata

profiles.main: shell + text inventory; unknown furniture dimensions predicted
profiles.explicit_constraints: main plus user-supplied constraints; identical for all methods

evaluation_layers: all-request exact inventory and interface success
bbox geometry, requested and fixed collisions, size plausibility
door-seeded agent reachability, opening clearance, functional access, proxy support
real mesh coverage/semantics/fit distortion/contact/collision and optional physical stability
batch1 warm/cold and decomposed downstream end-to-end latency
auxiliary_only: FID/KID and visual distribution with controlled rendering

aggregation.request_denominator: all selected room requests including failures
aggregation.conditional_quality: report metric coverage alongside scores; invalid outputs do not count as zero collisions
aggregation.uncertainty: paired source/group cluster bootstrap with source and density strata

current_artifact_profile.scope: Existing heldout artifact only; no inference, training or API.

data_and_run_requirements: freeze canonical condition hashes before fresh method predictions
keep historical full-condition predictions under their original protocol
preserve original shell and openings through downstream geometry
use same downstream asset generation/fitting configuration and seeds
do not claim new model scores until main-profile predictions exist
